blurb: Blue Mash Golf Course is a public golf course located in Laytonsville, Maryland, featuring a mix of links-style, parkland, wooded, and water holes designed by Arthur Hills. The course is manageable for beginners and challenging for low handicap players. Facilities include a clubhouse with a pro shop, locker rooms, dining area, bar menu, a 10,000-square-foot putting green, grass-tee driving range, and short-game area.
extraNote: No show without 24-hour cancellation results in full charge · May be charged for missing players at discretion of golf shop · Rain checks offered if course closes due to weather
